design: Ten deterministic joint parameter holdouts authored and sealed before v02 controller freeze. Not a random sample, confidence interval, or real-world generalization estimate.
previous_data: All v01 development and v01 heldout cases are now regression data; none count as unseen evaluation.
comparison: Paired unchanged v01 mounted-rake recovery versus v02 continuous-grip recovery; same native geometry and case parameters.
cohort_access: Controller development must not read or execute this fresh cohort before root records source freeze. No fresh-case outcomes used to tune the controller.
rationale: Eight reachable-tool conditions span mass, friction, position and initial alignment; two insufficient-tool controls test deferral. Parameters intentionally differ jointly, so individual-factor causal effects are not isolated.

criteria.support_scope: Normal force from world, rake, or non-finger robot geometry each must remain below 0.01 N. Thresholds are synthetic scoring conventions, not calibrated safety limits.
criteria.height_scope: Height is the synthetic shoe body origin at its sole-bottom reference, not its orientation-dependent lowest surface.
